- name: lowercase-hyphenated identifier (e.g., "self-attention")
- aliases: alternative names (e.g., "scaled dot-product attention")

"WSP") as a standalone concept unless its expansion is inferable from the
surrounding text. When an acronym clearly abbreviates a known concept, put
it in that concept's aliases instead; if the expansion is not inferable,
drop the acronym entirely.
